name: alert
title: Alert
description: Presentational alert with the shared tones (neutral, info, success, warning, destructive), a trailing action slot, long text that wraps, and an opt-in live role.
docs: Put an optional icon (`aria-hidden`), `AlertTitle` and `AlertDescription` inside. `action` takes a trailing Button; it moves below the text when the alert is narrower than 28rem. An alert is not a live region by default: pass `live` for one that appears after the page loads, and it becomes `role="alert"` for warning and destructive tones and `role="status"` otherwise. `announce` still works and is deprecated.
